title: The Impersonal Critical Gaze and Exhibition Review
goal: Write with an objective critical gaze using impersonal se before intransitive verbs and human a-objects, and read a full exhibition review.
grammar: impersonal se with intransitive/prepositional verbs and invariable singular se before personal a + plural human objects

items: I can use invariable singular impersonal se before personal a + plural human objects (se invita a los visitantes, se homenajea a las artesanas).
I can distinguish impersonal se from agreeing passive se in exhibition reviews.
I can follow a full exhibition review analysing curatorial structure, lighting, ceramics, charcoal drawings, and critical reservations.
